row.notes: Fills a 0x1c-byte output {+0 float, +4 float intensity, +8 int32 texture/decal slot (-1 default), +0xc float3 colour, +0x18 flag bits} from material parameters looked up with Render_Material_FindParamIndexByHash using hash keys stored in pkg at +0x2c8, +0x2d8, +0x2e8, +0x2f8, +0x308, +0x4d8, and decal entries via Render_DecalLookup_ResolveEntry(pkg+0x318 / pkg+0x4b8, reads +0x160). When the +0x4d8 param is zero the colour is converted sRGB to linear (0.04045 / 12.92 / 2.4 curve) and multiplied by the scalar, setting flag 4; colour components above 1.0 raise errno 0x22. Parameter names are hashes only, so the exact meaning of each field is inferred; handles both material layouts (material+0x30 < 2 sparse table, else +0x100 block stride 0x48).
